facts.source_fact: Site visits are an important part of annual verification and absence of a visit can prevent a positive opinion.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve site-visit importance without guaranteeing outcome.

facts.source_fact: A site visit must take place when the operator has changed verifier.
A site visit must take place when there has been no site visit for the preceding two annual-emissions-reporting scheme years.
A site visit must take place after a significant monitoring-plan modification in the scheme year.
Changes to default values in monitoring plans are not treated as significant for this site-visit trigger.
HSEs are treated as category A installations for site-visit purposes.
HSEs do not need regulator approval for a site-visit waiver.
facts.expected_handling: Do not invent regulator-waiver approval for HSEs.

facts.source_fact: The verifier must give the operator written justification for a site-visit waiver.
The verifier must keep a copy of the waiver justification in internal verification documentation.
Virtual site visits based on force majeure are considered case by case.
